duplicate_policy: 64 matching anchors per stroke after the shared placement, rounded to 8 decimals; matching only, output points unchanged
selection_rule: largest margin with expected character-mean geometry <= 1.01 * D and expected terminal angle <= D + 0.5 degrees; expected values use actual sampler probabilities; otherwise margin 0
confirmation: remaining compatible wsq test characters not in terminal_selection confirmation; same frozen training-only profile/pool
confirmed_scope: candidate-based reproducible variation, not a measured within-character natural handwriting distribution

component_naturalness_evidence.grouping: same writer, canonical, variant, role, parent layout, stroke count
component_naturalness_evidence.normalization: one common translation and positive scale
component_naturalness_evidence.descriptor: 16 arclength matching anchors + normalized stroke lengths + terminal directions at 8% and 20% of each stroke
component_naturalness_evidence.calibration: character-held-out nearest-neighbor distances, per-character median, 95th percentile
component_naturalness_evidence.leakage_control: remove target character before fitting; remove donor character when evaluating a generated exemplar
component_naturalness_evidence.variation_gate: at least two near-best distinct shapes within empirical range, otherwise deterministic D
component_naturalness_evidence.claim: compatibility with observed same-component variation across characters; not direct repeated-character variance
